motive.zhHans: 他的贸易公司快要破产了，所以他需要钱。他暗中决定为自己的秘书投保人寿保险，然后杀了他以骗取保险金。Shioji 是替他调换面具的人，真面具被保管在羽田机场，因为他偷走假面具后要求 Richard 支付一百万日元，他知道警卫告诉 Iwami 的密码，而且没有被监控录像拍到。Kaneko 开始在他那座正被拆除的废弃大楼地下室（即员工办公室）里勒索他，用的是拍到他的所有不利照片。然而，他并不知道 Kaneko 在电脑上留了一份照片副本，以便继续勒索他，但这一举动最终帮助柯南破解了此案。由于 Kaneko 绑架柯南是为了阻止他的调查，Hosoo 便让他和摄像师一起等死，因为他可能成为证人。
motive.en: His trading company was going under, so he needed the money. He decided in secret to take out a life insurance policy for his secretary and then killed him to get the money. Shioji was the one who replaced the mask for him and the real one is secured at Haneda Airport, since he asked Richard to pay a million yen for it, after stolen the one false since he knew the code given by the security guard to Iwami and wasn't seen in the surveillance footage. Kaneko had started to blackmail him at the basement of his abandoned building being torn down, which was the staff office, using all incriminating photos he had taken of him. However, unbeknownst to him, Kaneko had kept a copy of the pictures on his computer, so that he could continue to blackmail him, but this action ultimately helped Conan to solve this case. Since Kaneko had kidnapped Conan in order to stop his investigation, Hosoo left him to die along with the cameraman because he could be a witness.

evidence.en: While he was committing the murder, a button fell from his sleeve and was later found in the car engine. He was supposed to have changed his polo at the Hotel New Baker, but was found by his accounting secretary during a work's discussion.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Takuya Hosoo。他就是那个动了刹车手脚、只为给自己制造不在场证明的人。他本应撞上安全隔离墩，却因柯南的干预而冲进了纸箱堆。这样一来，他看上去像是受到了什么人的威胁。他的贸易公司快要破产了，所以他需要钱。他暗中决定为自己的秘书投保人寿保险，然后杀了他以骗取保险金。他在行凶时从袖口掉下一颗纽扣，后来在汽车发动机里被找到。他本应在 Hotel New Baker 换掉他的马球衫，却被会计秘书在工作讨论期间发现。Shioji 是替他调换面具的人，真面具被保管在羽田机场，因为他偷走假面具后要求 Richard 支付一百万日元，他知道警卫告诉 Iwami 的密码，而且没有被监控录像拍到。然而，当她得知 Takahashi 遇害后，他那复仇心切的女友向 Megure 坦白了一切。Kaneko 开始在他那座正被拆除的废弃大楼地下室（即员工办公室）里勒索他，用的是拍到他的所有不利照片。他付钱给 Kaneko 买下存储卡，但最终决定杀掉摄像师让他永远闭嘴。然而，他并不知道 Kaneko 在电脑上留了一份照片副本，以便继续勒索他，但这一举动最终帮助柯南破解了此案。Iwami 被监控摄像头拍到受到 Kaneko 的威胁和勒索，Kaneko 看到他走进歌舞伎博物馆，尽管摄像师知道他并没有偷面具。由于 Kaneko 绑架柯南是为了阻止他的调查，Hosoo 便让他和摄像师一起等死，因为他可能成为证人。Hosoo 被捕后，令柯南惊讶的是，Ebizo 想让那位大侦探沉睡的小五郎出演他的下一场演出，而醒来的小五郎仍然相信自己就是犯人。
resolution.en: The culprit is Takuya Hosoo. He was the one who manipulated his brakes just to make an alibi to himself. He was supposed to have crashed into a safety barrels, but ended up in the paper station due to Conan's intervention. That way, he looked like he was being threatened by someone. His trading company was going under, so he needed the money. He decided in secret to take out a life insurance policy for his secretary and then killed him to get the money. While he was committing the murder, a button fell from his sleeve and was later found in the car engine. He was supposed to have changed his polo at the Hotel New Baker, but was found by his accounting secretary during a work's discussion. Shioji was the one who replaced the mask for him and the real one is secured at Haneda Airport, since he asked Richard to pay a million yen for it, after stolen the one false since he knew the code given by the security guard to Iwami and wasn't seen in the surveillance footage. However, when she learns Takahashi's murder, his vengeful girlfriend confesses all to Megure. Kaneko had started to blackmail him at the basement of his abandoned building being torn down, which was the staff office, using all incriminating photos he had taken of him. He payed Kaneko for the memory card, but ultimately decided to kill the cameraman to keep him quiet. However, unbeknownst to him, Kaneko had kept a copy of the pictures on his computer, so that he could continue to blackmail him, but this action ultimately helped Conan to solve this case. Iwami was seen on the surveillance camera threatened and blackmailed by Kaneko, who saw him going inside the Kabuki museum, even if the cameraman knew that he didn't steal the mask. Since Kaneko had kidnapped Conan in order to stop his investigation, Hosoo left him to die along with the cameraman because he could be a witness. After Hosoo's arrest, with Conan's surprise, Ebizo wants to put the great detective Sleeping Kogoro, who is awakened still beliving him the culprit, in his next show.
